argentina_brazil.scene: Iguazu Falls seen from the Brazilian side across to the Argentine cascades, low river-level viewpoint beside wet subtropical rocks with a delicate rainbow in drifting mist, soft early morning sidelight.

argentina_brazil_chile.alt: Каскады Игуасу на границе Аргентины и Бразилии
argentina_brazil_chile.scene: Iguazu Falls on the Argentina-Brazil border, intimate elevated oblique view along a row of powerful cascades with a broad dark-green rainforest canopy and backlit white mist, cloudy silver-blue morning. Connect Argentina and Brazil within this three-country route.

argentina_brazil_chile_peru.scene: Shared Argentine-Chilean Patagonia: a pair of guanacos beside a turquoise glacial lake beneath layered snow-covered Andean peaks, very wide windswept open steppe, late afternoon amber light, low eye-level perspective. A coherent Patagonia scene linking Argentina and Chile, without unrelated monuments.

argentina_brazil_chile_uruguay.alt: Горная дорога через Анды Аргентины и Чили
argentina_brazil_chile_uruguay.scene: The Andes between Argentina and Chile, a serpentine high mountain road below monumental layered reddish rock walls and distant snowy summits, clear deep blue sky, road curves from lower right towards central pass, no close vehicles, warm side lighting.

argentina_brazil_peru.scene: Vast Amazon basin shared by Brazil and Peru: a graceful dark river bend through unbroken tropical rainforest, a small traditional wooden riverboat in the middle distance, low aerial cinematic view, pale sunrise mist hovering over trees, authentic lush humid nature.

argentina_brazil_uruguay.scene: Broad Rio de la Plata estuary shared by Argentina and Uruguay: a white sailing yacht crosses calm silver water, distant low historic Colonia del Sacramento coastline and lighthouse, apricot dusk with lavender clouds, camera at water level from a second boat, tranquil authentic river travel.

argentina_chile.alt: Андские вершины и озеро в Патагонии
argentina_chile.scene: Shared Argentina-Chile Patagonia: majestic snow-covered Andean mountains rising behind a pale turquoise lake, lenga forest with autumn gold along a rocky shore in foreground, crisp dawn side lighting, cinematic wide travel photograph, no famous peaks combined incorrectly.

argentina_chile_peru.scene: High Andes spanning Peru, Chile and Argentina: a small herd of vicunas on a golden altiplano plain with a brilliant cobalt high-altitude lake and distant snow-covered volcanic cone, low camera at animal eye height, clear high mountain light, authentic documentary nature scene.

argentina_chile_uruguay.alt: Маяк и горные берега пролива Бигль
argentina_chile_uruguay.scene: Beagle Channel in Tierra del Fuego shared by Argentina and Chile: low red-and-white navigation lighthouse on a rocky island surrounded by a few sea lions, layered dark mountains on both sides of a narrow sea channel, storm clouds opening to a warm shaft of sunset light, distant view with ample landscape.

argentina_peru.alt: Ламы и террасные поля в Андах
argentina_peru.scene: Andean cultural landscape linking Argentina and Peru: terraced highland fields in muted ochre and green, dry-stone walls, a small group of llamas on an old mountain trail beneath rolling high Andes, soft golden dawn mist, documentary travel photography, no Machu Picchu or other monument falsely placed in Argentina.

argentina_uruguay.scene: An intimate broad Rio de la Plata shoreline at dawn: two people seen from far behind sharing a traditional wooden mate gourd beside a thermos on a rustic riverside bench, quiet silver water and pastel sky with distant sailing boats. Shared river and mate culture linking Argentina and Uruguay.

belize_costa-rica.alt: Тукан над тропической рекой Центральной Америки
belize_costa-rica.scene: Caribbean rainforest river landscape shared in spirit by Belize and Costa Rica: a keel-billed toucan perched on a mossy branch over a calm emerald creek, wet broad leaves and distant misty jungle, horizontal eye-level wildlife photograph with toucan at center-right and lush surrounding scenery.

belize_costa-rica_el-salvador.alt: Волна у вулканического побережья Тихого океана
belize_costa-rica_el-salvador.scene: Pacific volcanic coastline of Costa Rica and El Salvador: one graceful peeling surf wave beside a black-sand beach and distant palm-fringed headland, a tiny surfer farther out gives scale, early morning blue light, wide shoreline view, one natural coherent tropical Pacific scene.

belize_costa-rica_el-salvador_guatemala.scene: A Maya stone pyramid in the Peten forest landscape shared by Belize and Guatemala, seen emerging above dense green rainforest from a distant elevated viewpoint, rising morning mist, a pair of scarlet macaws crossing near the canopy, authentic limestone stepped temple, no invented oversized architecture.

belize_costa-rica_el-salvador_honduras.alt: Коралловый риф и остров Карибского моря
belize_costa-rica_el-salvador_honduras.scene: Caribbean reef seascape linking Belize and Honduras: a small palm-covered cay at the edge of brilliant turquoise reef shallows and deep cobalt sea, oblique low aerial viewpoint, clear water revealing coral patches, a tiny white sailboat distant, tranquil midday tropical light.

belize_costa-rica_el-salvador_mexico.scene: Mesoamerican Barrier Reef shared by Belize and Mexico: an underwater green sea turtle gliding over a healthy coral garden with schools of small yellow fish, sunlight rays through clear aqua water, wide natural underwater editorial photograph, no scuba people near camera.

belize_costa-rica_el-salvador_nicaragua.alt: Озеро в вулканической кальдере Центральной Америки
belize_costa-rica_el-salvador_nicaragua.scene: Volcanic Central America connecting Costa Rica and Nicaragua: a broad freshwater crater lake in an emerald tropical volcanic caldera, lush forest foreground and hazy mountain rim under puffy clouds, high panoramic viewpoint, soft afternoon light, no lava or dramatic eruption.

belize_costa-rica_el-salvador_panama.scene: Shared Caribbean forest ecosystem of Costa Rica and Panama: a three-toed sloth hanging naturally from a thick branch among lush rainforest leaves, gentle daylight filtering through humid mist, small animal occupying middle third amid rich green landscape, realistic wildlife photograph.

belize_costa-rica_guatemala.alt: Каменная стела майя в лесной археологической зоне
belize_costa-rica_guatemala.scene: Maya culture linking Belize and Guatemala: ancient carved limestone stela and worn stone steps in a quiet jungle archaeological clearing, roots and soft ferns foreground, warm slanting morning rays, no legible modern text, authentic subtle carving, wide ground-level documentary photo.

belize_costa-rica_guatemala_honduras.alt: Каменная резьба майя среди тропической зелени
belize_costa-rica_guatemala_honduras.scene: Maya heritage of Guatemala and Honduras: detailed weathered stone animal-head carving beside a low ancient stepped stone platform in a lush green jungle clearing, quiet morning after rain, wide oblique documentary travel view, carved stone centerpiece with rich natural vegetation.
